en.bilal-muhammad: Ahmad b. Harun al-Fami (ra) narrated to us. He said: Muhammad b. `Abdullah b. Ja`far narrated to us from his father from Muhammad b. `Abd al-Jabbar from `Abd al-Rahman b. Abi Najran from al-Hasan b. `Ali b. Rabat from Abi Bakr al-Hadrami. He said: Al-Sadiq Ja`far b. Muhammad (as) said:
Be good to your parents, and your children will be good to you. Be chaste with the women of the people, and your women will be chaste.
